title: Il faut brûler maman (FCP 2026)
synopsis: In a family of undertakers, two sisters and a brother reunite for their mother's funeral. With the staff on strike, they must carry out the funeral arrangements themselves. How will they agree on how to cremate Mom?

synopsis_lang.en: In a family of undertakers, two sisters and a brother reunite for their mother's funeral. With the staff on strike, they must carry out the funeral arrangements themselves. How will they agree on how to cremate Mom?
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 在一個殯儀世家裏，兩姊妹和一個兄弟因母親的葬禮重聚。因員工正在罷工，他們唯有親自處理葬禮事宜。就如何火化母親遺體的方式，他們各有意見。看他們如何達成共識?

cast: Louise Coldefy, Julia Piaton, Albert Dupontel
